1482:
WITH consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment" AS segment,
        SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4)
),

pct_change AS (
    SELECT
        y12.segment AS segment,
        y12.total_consumption AS consumption_2012,
        y13.total_consumption AS consumption_2013,
        (y13.total_consumption - y12.total_consumption) / y13.total_consumption * 100 AS pct_increase
    FROM consumption_by_year y12
    JOIN consumption_by_year y13
      ON y12.segment = y13.segment
     AND y12.year = '2012'
     AND y13.year = '2013'
)

SELECT
    (SELECT segment FROM pct_change ORDER BY pct_increase DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT pct_increase FROM pct_change ORDER BY pct_increase DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_pct,
    (SELECT segment FROM pct_change ORDER BY pct_increase ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT pct_increase FROM pct_change ORDER BY pct_increase ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_pct
1526:
WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "customerid"
    FROM "transactions_1k"
    WHERE "date" = DATE '2012-08-25'
      AND "amount" = 634.8
),

yearly AS (
    SELECT
        ym."customerid",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN target_customer tc ON tc."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY ym."customerid", SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4)
),

pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        "customerid",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2012",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY "customerid"
)

SELECT
    "customerid",
    "consumption_2012",
    "consumption_2013",
    ("consumption_2012" - "consumption_2013") / "consumption_2012" AS "consumption_decrease_rate"
FROM pivoted;
